summary.name: FireHydrant
summary.one_liner: FireHydrant is an incident management platform that combines on-call scheduling, alerting, runbooks, Slack/Teams incident response, AI-assisted summaries, and retrospectives.
use_cases: coordinating incident response in Slack or Teams
scheduling on-call rotations and alerting engineers
generating AI incident summaries and status page updates
running post-incident retrospectives and tracking action items
summary.what_it_does: FireHydrant is a platform for planning, responding to, and resolving incidents. It offers on-call scheduling and alerting, a service catalog showing service ownership and dependencies, and automated runbooks for codifying response steps. Incidents can be managed within Slack or Teams, and status pages can be updated to keep stakeholders informed. Its AI features generate incident summaries, transcribe Zoom and Google Meet meetings, and produce retrospectives with captured action items. The page also lists analytics for MTTx metrics, plus enterprise features such as SSO, RBAC, audit logs, SCIM, and a public API with Terraform support.
notable: AI-enhanced retrospectives and automatic follow-up action items
Live Zoom and Google Meet transcription with automatic decision documentation
350+ API endpoints, Terraform support and SDKs
SOC 2 compliance with SSO, RBAC, audit logs and SCIM
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; it only claims cost-conscious pricing
Page is mostly marketing claims, such as a 90% faster resolution figure and a 91% MTTm reduction quoted from one customer, and these are not independently verified
